_comment: JEXI MCP server registry v3 (Sept 2026 — Lewis: connect them directly, no switches). Every server here was REALLY connected and tool-called by the live test (scripts/mcp-live-test.js, multiple rounds). No paid keys anywhere. uvx servers need Python+uv on the host; npx needs node; streamable-http needs only network. A memory-guarded few wake at boot; the rest connect lazily on first use — mcp/tool-directory.json lets the planner see every tool without holding 35 child processes. Phase 8 Scope F (Sept 2026): the 9 `category: security` additions (plus the security-marked `playwright`) are registered DECLARATIVELY from verified upstream sources — mcp-nmap and semgrep-mcp verified as published PyPI packages, the rest verified upstream GitHub repos. They are enabled:false (keyless where marked is a property of the tool, not an install claim) and were NOT live-verified in the build sandbox — enable only on a host that has provisioned the underlying tool.
